claims.statement: Safe food no longer marketable for people can legally be used as animal feed, and the EU feed-material catalogue expressly covers bakery and pasta industry products.
Registration or approval, HACCP-based hygiene controls, traceability, feed safety and accurate labelling are binding operating requirements, not optional marketplace features.
Packaging-contaminated former food cannot be used directly as feed, and animal-origin content invokes additional animal-by-product processing and use restrictions.
The Polish veterinary authority exposes the registered or approved feed-establishment population, so recipient registration can be checked from an official source.

There is real industrial activity around former-food feed: IUNGO already produces specified feed materials in Poland, and Trotec is constructing a Polish plant after adding more than 50000 tonnes of annual processing capacity through LIFE F3.

The direct incumbent offer is operationally integrated: collection equipment, weighing, registration, unpacking, thermal treatment, logistics, maintenance and compliance advice are already bundled by processors.

A software-only exchange may be viable only where it coordinates already licensed operators and owns a recurring compliance record; the evidence does not establish that matching alone is a control point.
No reviewed source establishes that generators or processors will pay the proposed recurring fee or take rate, or that local transport and feed value support repeat unit economics.

contrary_evidence: IUNGO is a long-standing Polish operator already sourcing, processing and selling food-industry side streams as feed materials.
Trotec is bringing an industrial former-food facility to Poland and already combines processing, logistics, sensor data and compliance support.
FeedValid offers integrated collection hardware, transport, weighing and registration across several European countries.
The legal boundary is stream-specific; packaging, contamination or animal-origin ingredients can block direct feed use.
The reviewed incumbent sites use negotiated commercial terms, providing no support for the candidate's subscription or take-rate assumptions.
